hits.snippet: [Press Release](https://news.sap.com/press-room/) by [SAP News](https://news.sap.com/author/colleenraftery/ "Posts by SAP News") March 27, 2026 ****_WALLDORF & REDWOOD CITY_**** — [SAP SE](http://www.sap.com/) (NYSE: SAP) and Reltio Inc. today announced that SAP has agreed to acquire Reltio, a leading master data management (MDM) software provider, to help customers make their SAP and non-SAP enterprise data AI-ready. Terms of the deal were not disclosed. Amplify the value of AI with your most powerful data [Learn how](https://www.sap.com/products/data-cloud.html) Once closed, the acquisition will strengthen SAP Business Data Cloud (SAP BDC)—integral for SAP's AI-First and Suite-First strategy—and accelerate the evolution of SAP BDC to a fully interoperable enterprise data platform for enterprise-wide agentic AI. It will provide customers with the tools they need to unify, cleanse and harmonize data across sources for superior enterprise-wide agentic AI. "Reltio is a natural fit with SAP," said Muhammad Alam, member of the Executive Board of SAP SE, SAP Product & Engineering. The acquisition is intended to strengthen SAP Business Data Cloud and make enterprise data suitable for AI.** With the acquisition of Reltio, SAP aims to address a common problem: business data is often scattered across multiple systems and domains. As a result, AI cannot function optimally. Reltio’s platform brings structured and unstructured data together into a single reliable “golden record” via AI-based entity resolution. This identifies and merges related data records in different formats.
